intro: What the runs showed, the runs that show it, and what changed because of it. A finding with nothing changed yet says so.

lessons.finding: Without a slot save path, the model server refused to erase its slot, so each job's prompt stayed for the next job.
lessons.change: An empty, read-only save path ([troubleshooting 12](../troubleshooting/12-slot-erase-needs-a-save-path.md)), then an erase before each job that refuses the job when it fails ([ADR 0032](../decisions/0032-erase-the-slot-before-each-job-and-refuse-on-failure.md)).

lessons.finding: Workflow pods waited for a token secret that Argo's install did not create, until the workflow's deadline.
lessons.change: The manifests create the executor's token ([troubleshooting 14](../troubleshooting/14-workflow-pods-wait-for-the-executors-token.md)).

lessons.finding: All three small models followed injected text in the evidence, and all three called the `refuted` case confirmed.
lessons.change: No control relies on the model ignoring injected text ([A1](../security/ai-threats.md)). Qwen3.5-4B stayed ([ADR 0031](../decisions/0031-qwen3-5-4b-stays-the-workers-model.md)).

lessons.finding: A check of the job's status passed a wrong answer.
lessons.change: The workflow compares the model's verdict with two deterministic checks, and stops on anything but a match ([ADR 0041](../decisions/0041-the-workflow-compares-the-models-verdict-with-the-checks.md)).

lessons.finding: The tool service refused calls for another job's documents, and a document with a field outside its schema.
lessons.change: Nothing: evidence per job held as designed ([ADR 0040](../decisions/0040-a-jobs-evidence-is-collected-on-the-hosts-and-stored-per-job.md)).

lessons.finding: The model read results by their position when the tool service answered them in another order.
lessons.change: The task asks for one document at a time ([troubleshooting 18](../troubleshooting/18-tool-results-come-back-in-another-order.md)).

lessons.finding: Right verdicts in a form the comparison cannot read stop the workflow.
lessons.change: Two task sentences made it rarer. A structured output ([ADR 0049](../decisions/0049-a-netbox-jobs-answer-is-a-final-output-checked-against-a-schema.md)) ended it in twelve eval jobs ([record](2026-10-27-2016-structured-output-eval.md)), though an output can still leave out an account ([#221](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/221)).

lessons.finding: Thinking on took 1.8 times as long, for no better answer, in two jobs each way.
lessons.change: Thinking stays off. How it does on harder cases is not tested ([#36](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/36)).

lessons.finding: A job at its time limit leaves the model's slot unerased.
lessons.change: The erase before the next job empties it. A 512-token prompt batch lets the cancel through ([ADR 0052](../decisions/0052-a-smaller-prompt-batch-so-a-cancel-reaches-the-model-server-in-time.md)), shown by the timeout drill below.

lessons.finding: No wrong verdict ended in a match. Both wrong verdicts said `within` where the checks said `missing`.
lessons.change: Nothing yet. The comparison stopped both.

lessons.finding: Where the two checks disagreed, no answer said the evidence disagrees.
lessons.change: Nothing yet. No case has documents that disagree in the task's sense ([#205](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/205)).

lessons.finding: A job called Goose's own `load_skill`, and no audit record holds that call.
lessons.change: Nothing yet ([#207](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/207)).

lessons.finding: Thinking on and off proposed the right fix in all four jobs. Off, the model wrote its reasoning into the answer and took as long.
lessons.change: Thinking stays off ([#36](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/36)).

lessons.finding: The rehearsal passed a patch with a change to the delivery account, because it tests the contract's accounts only. The policy refused it.
lessons.change: None: the policy names the accounts a fix may touch, and the rehearsal is evidence, not proof ([ADR 0043](../decisions/0043-proposals-are-remove-only-and-a-policy-check-decides.md)).

lessons.finding: One answer proposed removing the consumer's own scoped permission. The comparison stopped it on a wrong verdict, and the policy refuses a permission the checks do not call excess.
lessons.change: None: two controls blocked it.

lessons.finding: A workflow started at the compare step matched an answer the operator wrote, with no model. The proposal command refused it.
lessons.change: The proposal command checks the workflow's entrypoint and its one comparison ([#203](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/203)).

lessons.finding: In four jobs, the model proposed six removals that would each leave an account under-privileged, and the policy refused every one.
lessons.change: None: the policy checks the account against its access specification after the removal ([ADR 0043](../decisions/0043-proposals-are-remove-only-and-a-policy-check-decides.md)).

lessons.finding: The schema more than doubled each job's first prompt, to 3,475 tokens, and reading it took about 274 seconds instead of 95.
lessons.change: None: a job still ends within its 20-minute limit ([ADR 0049](../decisions/0049-a-netbox-jobs-answer-is-a-final-output-checked-against-a-schema.md), [worklog](../worklogs/0006-remediation-pull-requests-and-delivery.md#the-eval-run-after-the-fix)).

lessons.finding: Both jobs put a verdict under each account's name in one accepted call. The two-account schema added 321 tokens to the first prompt, read in 309 seconds.
lessons.change: The schema names each account ([ADR 0051](../decisions/0051-a-netbox-jobs-schema-names-each-account-of-the-job.md)), and a job with no checks' verdicts fails before it runs.

lessons.finding: With a 512-token prompt batch, a timed-out job's cancel reached the model server, and the slot was erased 14 seconds later.
lessons.change: None. [ADR 0052](../decisions/0052-a-smaller-prompt-batch-so-a-cancel-reaches-the-model-server-in-time.md) is confirmed, and [#199](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/199) closes.

lessons.finding: A terminated workflow skips the exit handler. The dispatch step's own signal handler revoked the token, and the worker ended `cancelled` with the slot erased.
lessons.change: None. The revoke in the signal handler, from [#174](https://github.com/sindredg/ai-security-platform/issues/174), is confirmed.

lessons.finding: A checks' verdicts item written by root is trusted to the verification gate. One with the collection's verdicts matched; one the live evidence contradicts stopped there.
lessons.change: None. `W.12` names who can write the item, an item older than an hour is refused, and the rest is the [T23 accepted risk](../security/accepted-risks.md#accepted-risks).

lessons.finding: The drill's first run ran no sandbox probe: systemd-run takes a symbolic address only alone. Then: `sysctl -w` exits 0 when ignored, and systemd read a shell `${...}` form.
lessons.change: One property per address, the setting written as a file, the status parsed with `tail` and `head`, and an empty read fails ([worklog](../worklogs/0007-operational-and-containment-drills.md#slice-2-forbidden-calls-from-the-worker)).
